clean: Nothing changed: the working tree is clean
upToDate: up to date (as of the last fetch)
noUpstream: This branch has no upstream yet.
untrusted: Pull and push run the repository's hooks and filters, so they ask to trust this folder first.
amendHelp: Reword the last commit, or add files to it once they are staged
applyHelp: Bring these changes back and keep the stash
popHelp: Bring these changes back and drop the stash
